column1: # Lens 26 to 75: n, layout, lens slots, depth, lens entries, chain, faint twists, deals kept to pick from.
# Depth climbs from 13 to 36 by level 53, nearly twice the first 25's slope, and holds at 33 to 36: past that a level
# is a grind, not a harder puzzle. From 44 every deal is a chain (one right move a step), lenses hold two or three
# entries each, a quarter of the depth or more, so some still zoom by two steps, and faint twists rise, so the last
# chapters are harder to crack at the same depth. Levels whose hub is a lens hold at 29 to 32: past that one proof at
# par takes the solver over twenty minutes.
